backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining user profiles, access control, logs, uploads, questions, and pre‑trip checklists with supporting types and storage maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a router‑stability fix to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file including pages, hooks, and components.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH color variables, light/dark themes, and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top‑level React app configuring TanStack Router with a stable router instance and defining user/admin routes with auth guards.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Empty file placeholder for a profile setup modal component.
frontend/src/components/checklists/Check: Read‑only checklist viewer showing driver info and categorized checklist items with check status indicators.
frontend/src/components/header/AppHeader: Application header displaying branding, user profile info, admin badge, and sign‑in/sign‑out controls tied to local auth.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading/storing identity and exposing login/logout state and actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalActor.ts: Builds a backend actor using locally stored identities and refreshes queries when the actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalAuth.tsx: Implements local Ed25519 identity storage, login, logout, and initialization via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, logs, uploads, and checklist operations using the local actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for light and dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardL: Renders the main admin dashboard with navigation, fetches aggregate counts for logs, uploads, questions, and checklists, and redirects to the logs page by default.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllChecklistsPa: Displays all users’ saved checklists with user filtering, sorting by timestamp, and a modal for viewing checklist details.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllDocumentsPag: Shows all uploaded documents across users with filtering, sorting, file previewing, and download support.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllLogsPage.tsx: Lists all user log entries with filtering and sorting, showing details like timestamps, titles, and notes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllQuestionsPag: Manages all user-submitted questions with filtering, status updates, sorting, and admin reply functionality.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login page where users create a local identity, register with the backend, and are routed based on admin status.
frontend/src/pages/user/MyChecklistsPage: Renders the user's pre‑trip checklists, allowing creation, item checking, and viewing past submissions.
Displays uploaded documents and supports uploading, viewing, and downloading files with progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/user/MyLogsPage.tsx: Manages user truck logs with create, edit, delete, and list functionality.
Lets users submit questions and view previously submitted ones with a simple modal form.
frontend/src/pages/user/UserDashboardLay: Provides the user dashboard layout with navigation among logs, documents, questions, and checklists.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash‑based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config defining content paths, theme extensions for colors, radii, shadows, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata including schema version, known sign-in glitch issue, existing feature request, and project summary.
